propositions: Network-capable git call sites in gerrit_client.py and workspace.py lack explicit timeouts and can block indefinitely on stuck remotes or hung credential helpers
TimeoutExpired exceptions raised by unbounded git calls in gerrit_client.py bypass token redaction, creating a credential-disclosure path via the URL in TimeoutExpired.cmd
Five subprocess.run calls in gerrit_client.py clone_change_ref and the _git helper in workspace.py must be bounded with _GIT_TIMEOUT=300 matching the precedent from bug 747f
Timeout exceptions must be caught and converted to module-specific errors (GerritError and WorkspaceError) that name the operation and bound without exposing credentials
The _ref_lock.py module is already fully bounded via a required timeout parameter on its _git seam and requires no changes
